title: Truc Khe · Nam Linh
intro: Four appearances, one journey. Your story begins in a small village in Nam Linh.
name: Character name
controls: Click the ground to walk · Click a villager to talk
emptyBag: Your inventory is empty. Explore the forest and mountains to gather materials.
questText: Talk to the scholar, healer and blacksmith.
questComplete: You know the villagers now. Explore the western forest and eastern mountains.
welcome: Welcome to Truc Khe, {name}. Meet the three village guides.
blocked: That spot is unreachable. Walking to the nearest reachable point.
cooldown: These materials are regrowing. Come back later.
talk.teacher: A journey starts with knowing where you stand. Meet Lac To and Thiet Son. They will help you prepare for your first expedition.
talk.healer: Thanh Tam leaves grow in the western forest. Leave the roots when you gather them so the plants can grow again.
talk.smith: A good sword needs good iron. The Xich Nham Mountains to the east hold rich ore, but beware of the beasts guarding it.
talk.amoc: I love walking by the stream. Cross the western bridge to the forest, or take the eastern road to the mountains.
talk.bangi: A new face in our village! Visit the healer and prepare before you travel far.
talk.guard: A landslide blocks Thien Lo. Return to the village to prepare. Travel to the next region will open later.
talk.monster: The creature watches you. Combat is not available in this exploration build.
loadError: Images could not load. Check your connection and try again.
saved: Your appearance and inventory are saved on this device.
canvas: Truc Khe world. Click to move.
help: Click an NPC name in the quest to walk there automatically.
audioHint: Sound starts only when you enable it.
mapHint: Click the map to choose a destination.
talk.adao: The flowers by the clinic are blooming! I am going to ask Lac To for some seeds.
talk.benam: The blacksmith told me to slow down. But the eastern bridge is so pretty, I want to see it!
talk.chulam: I tend the bamboo every morning. Feel free to rest in the garden on your way.
